verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows extensive text docs and a reference to an api-reference path, but no evidence of an interactive, runnable-example API reference (e.g., embedded code sandbox, live API console); in fact the OpenAPI/swagger probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, indicating no discoverable interactive spec. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable code snippets, or a live OpenAPI/Swagger UI.
